strings.name: Jürgen Klopp
strings.summary: Klopp became Mainz's coach after playing for the club, won promotion, then led Dortmund to league titles and a domestic double. At Liverpool he combined counterpressing, transitions and team building to win the Champions League and the club's first Premier League title. After leaving in 2024, he briefly led Red Bull's global soccer operations before becoming Germany coach in 2026.
